name: tariff-risk-and-margin

findings.what_changed: Acme added a risk that tariffs on imported battery cells could raise its costs.
findings.why_it_matters: Tariffs now apply to the cells Acme imports from Asia.

findings.what_changed: Acme says tariffs on imported battery cells reduced its gross margin.
findings.why_it_matters: The tariff risk has already hurt Acme's profitability.

findings.what_changed: Acme added a patent lawsuit over its charging connector design.
findings.why_it_matters: An adverse ruling could require Acme to redesign the connector.

why: The tariff risk and the tariff margin hit are one matter; the patent suit is another.

name: recall-risk-and-lawsuit

findings.what_changed: Acme added a risk that its brake recall could lead to lawsuits.
findings.why_it_matters: Claims from the recall may cost Acme money.

findings.what_changed: Acme added a class action over the brake recall.
findings.why_it_matters: Customers allege the brake defect harmed them.

why: The risk the recall brings lawsuits, and the lawsuit that was filed, are one matter.

name: three-unrelated

findings.what_changed: Acme added a risk of ransomware attacks on its factories.
Acme added a trademark dispute over its logo in Europe.
findings.why_it_matters: Acme may have to rebrand in some countries.

findings.what_changed: Acme now hedges its euro revenue with currency forwards.
findings.why_it_matters: Exchange-rate swings affect its results less.

why: Three different matters: nothing should be joined.

name: shared-words-different-matters

findings.what_changed: Acme added a risk from new data privacy laws in California.
findings.why_it_matters: Complying with the law may raise Acme's costs.

findings.what_changed: Acme added a lawsuit claiming its battery design infringes a patent.
findings.why_it_matters: Acme could owe damages if it loses.

why: Both mention the law, but privacy compliance and a patent suit are different matters.

name: recall-across-three-sections

findings.what_changed: Acme added a risk that its airbag recall could widen.
findings.why_it_matters: A larger recall would add costs.

findings.what_changed: Acme added lawsuits filed over the airbag recall.
findings.why_it_matters: Owners claim injuries from the airbags.

findings.what_changed: Acme says warranty costs rose because of the airbag recall.
findings.why_it_matters: The recall has already raised its costs.

why: One recall, seen in the risk factors, the lawsuits and the warranty costs.
